record.paper_title: Некоторые экстремальные задачи для векторных расслоений
record.original_question: Determine the optimal constant δ for planar lattice packings forced in continuous fields of convex figures in γ^3_2: what is the largest δ such that every continuous field of convex figures in γ^3_2 contains a fiber figure that admits a lattice packing of the plane with density at least δ? The established lower bound is δ≥3/4, and this bound is not sharp.

evidence.quote: Теорема 15. Всякое непрерывное поле выпуклых фигур в γ32 содержит фигуру, допускающую решетчатую упаковку на плоскости плотностью ≥ 3/4.
В отличие от теоремы Фари [4] данная нами оценка не является точной.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\gamma^3_2$ denote the tautological (canonical) $2$-plane bundle over the Grassmannian $G_2(\mathbb{R}^3)\cong\mathbb{RP}^2$, whose fiber over a point $L\in G_2(\mathbb{R}^3)$ is the $2$-dimensional linear subspace $L\subset\mathbb{R}^3$ itself.

A continuous field of convex figures in $\gamma^3_2$ is a continuous assignment $L\mapsto K(L)$ that to every fiber $L$ associates a planar convex body $K(L)\subset L$ (continuity is with respect to the Hausdorff metric, after identifying nearby fibers via the bundle structure).

For a planar convex body $K\subset\mathbb{R}^2$, let $\delta_L(K)$ denote its lattice packing density, i.e. the supremum, over all lattices $\Lambda\subset\mathbb{R}^2$ such that the translates $\{K+\lambda:\lambda\in\Lambda\}$ have pairwise disjoint interiors, of the upper density of $\bigcup_{\lambda\in\Lambda}(K+\lambda)$ in $\mathbb{R}^2$.

Define
$$\delta^* \;=\; \inf_{\{K(L)\}}\;\sup_{L\in G_2(\mathbb{R}^3)}\delta_L\bigl(K(L)\bigr),$$
where the infimum is taken over all continuous fields of convex figures in $\gamma^3_2$.

It is known that $\delta^*\geq 3/4$ and that this lower bound is not sharp. Determine the exact value of $\delta^*$.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not locate any published determination of the sharp constant for lattice-packing densities forced in continuous fields of convex figures over the tautological 2-plane bundle. Related literature on planar lattice packings of convex bodies (e.g. results pushing packing densities above 3/4) exists, but none addresses this specific extremal problem for continuous fields. The status is therefore not verifiable from available sources.

status_evidence.title: Packing convex bodies in the plane with density greater than 3/4
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses planar packings of convex bodies surpassing 3/4 density.
status_evidence.claim: Related results on the 3/4 threshold for planar packings exist, but do not resolve the extremal constant for continuous fields in γ^3_2.

status_evidence.title: Packing and Covering — Handbook chapter (G. Fejes Tóth)
status_evidence.snippet: Comprehensive survey of packing and covering densities for convex bodies.
status_evidence.claim: Standard surveys of planar lattice packing densities do not record a sharp value for this fibered/extremal problem.
